name: South Texas Sheet Metal, inc.
old_description: At South Texas Sheet Metal, we specialize in custom sheet metal fabrication for a wide range of applications.
about:
Founded in 1976, South Texas Sheet Metal, Inc. has operated from Houston, Texas for over four decades. The company specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication and ductwork installation, serving the Gulf Coast region from its facility on Hansen Road.

Its capabilities include fabricating spiral, oval, rectangular, and welded ductwork, as well as Uni-Strut components. The company also provides comprehensive ductwork design and installation services for residential, commercial, and industrial projects, and supplies wholesale sheet metal for large-scale construction ventures. With over 30 years of experience, the firm has completed more than 500 projects.

The client base includes general contractors, mechanical contractors, and project owners across residential, commercial, and industrial construction, as well as manufacturing sectors that require custom ductwork solutions.

According to the company, its team’s commitment to quality, innovation, and client satisfaction sets it apart, with a focus on turning concepts into reality for construction and manufacturing projects.

name: Southeastern Wire
old_description: We manufacture the highest quality Staples and Insulation Supports.
about:
Southeastern Wire Fabricators, Inc. operates from Hemingway, South Carolina, where it was founded in 1979 by Don and Ruth Gabella. What began as a small block building in the Gabella family yard has grown into a multi‑generational manufacturing operation employing three generations of the family and providing jobs in the local community.

The company specializes in mass‑producing wire staples and insulation supports for construction, landscaping, and irrigation applications. Its product line includes sod and irrigation staples, insulation supports, and components for above‑ground wiring. Southeastern Wire offers custom sizing, custom packaging, and custom shipping on every order, accommodating both large‑volume and small‑quantity requests.

Customers span the construction, landscaping, sod and irrigation, and insulation industries, as well as contractors installing above‑ground wiring. The company serves businesses of all sizes, from national distributors to local contractors, emphasizing flexibility in order quantities and packaging.

Southeastern Wire distinguishes itself with a family‑business approach: "think like a business, but act like a family." It highlights American‑made products, southern hospitality, and a willingness to tailor sizes, packaging, and shipping to each customer’s needs.

name: Southern Medical & Adaptive Solutions
old_description: Drug free back pain relief backed by clinical/case studies and can be worn discreetly under clothing.
about:
Southern Medical & Adaptive Solutions operates from a retail and clinical facility in Slidell, Louisiana. The company maintains store hours Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and provides both in-person and shipped equipment delivery.

The business supplies a range of orthopedic bracing, mobility aids, and custom orthotics from manufacturers such as DonJoy, AlignMed, and OA Nano. A staff podiatrist designs and fabricates custom orthotics from patient impressions, while the clinical team conducts comprehensive consultations for conditions spanning the spine, knee, shoulder, foot, and ankle. The company also manages insurance authorization and billing on behalf of patients, and delivers equipment including knee scooters, wheelchairs, power chairs, and traction devices.

Customers include individuals with osteoarthritis, degenerative disc disease, ligament injuries, and post-operative needs, as well as physicians' offices seeking a preferred provider for bracing and conservative treatment options. The product catalog addresses conditions such as knee osteoarthritis, spinal stenosis, plantar fasciitis, rotator cuff injuries, and ankle instability.

The company emphasizes conservative, non-pharmacological interventions backed by clinical studies, positioning its offerings as alternatives to surgery and medication in line with insurance guidelines that require conservative treatment trials before surgical approval.

name: Southern New Jersey Steel Co
old_description: The multifaceted capabilities of Southern New Jersey Steel enable us to provide an array of services to meet the most diverse project requirements.
about:
Southern New Jersey Steel (SNJS) operates from Vineland, New Jersey, tracing its roots to 1975. The company began as a steel contracting firm serving the construction industry across the Eastern United States.

SNJS provides structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication and erection services. Its partnering facilities hold American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC) certification and run CNC drill lines, CNC angle lines, and computerized plate burning equipment for oxygen and plasma cutting. The shop produces bolted shop connections, clips, lintels, one-piece trusses, and a range of miscellaneous items including stairs, rails, ladders, grating, spiral stairs, monumental stairs, glass railings, and bronze railings. Pipe rails are formed on a mandrel bending machine to eliminate extra components. The company also supplies steel joists and metal decking, manages erection through experienced subcontractors, and uses Tekla Structures for 3D drafting, BIM modeling, and engineering calculations.

The contractor works directly with public entities and general contractors on projects valued from hundreds to several million dollars. Its portfolio spans public construction such as schools, libraries, prisons, and municipal buildings; industrial work at refineries and manufacturing plants; private commercial projects including supermarkets, retail centers, and warehouses; medical facilities such as Shore Memorial Hospital and Kennedy Health; and higher education projects at Rowan University and the University of Pennsylvania. SNJS is also licensed for casino construction in New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

The company emphasizes performance and precision, aiming to deliver maximum customer satisfaction regardless of project complexity or timeline. It maintains bonding resources that meet mandatory criteria and holds approved-contractor status in multiple states for public works.
